summary.result: Test results were showed that the slump, slump flow and L-type compacting were decreased with increasing the content of polypropylene fiber.
summary.background: But, the Box-type passing and air content were increased with increasing the content of polypropylene fiber.
summary.method: The slump was $25.5{\sim}27.5cm$ , the slump flow was $60{\sim}65cm$ , the Box-type passing was $2{\sim}6cm$ , the L-type compacting was excellent and air content was $2.7{\sim}3.2cm%$ by the polypropylene fiber content 0.2%, respectively.
